result.title: VLMProbe: An Open-source Library for VLM Probing and Interpretation
result.summary: Understanding how vision-language models use visual information requires connecting internal representations to model behavior. We present vlmprobe, an open-source library that integrates lens readouts, attention attribution, causal interventions, and sparse autoencoder (SAE) analysis within a common model interface. Shared adapters, calibration and checkpoint utilities, evaluation pipelines, and visualizations support systematic analysis across architectures. Using this framework, we compare methods across vision-language, language, and vision models through matched case studies and controlled evaluations of pretrained sparse dictionaries. The comparisons show that representation readouts and spatial explanations depend on the analysis objective and observation site, and that local attribution estimates can disagree with measured intervention effects. SAE evaluations further expose distinct trade-offs in reconstruction fidelity, concept readout, and spatial localization. Together, these results support combining multiple forms of evidence to evaluate an interpretation. vlmprobe provides a reusable basis for selecting methods, comparing their conclusions, and testing hypotheses about model behavior. The code is available on github.com/ubc-tea/vlm-probe

AI.brief_summary: 该文发布开源工具库 vlmprobe，把 lens 读出、注意力归因、因果干预与 SAE 分析统一到同一模型接口下，并在视觉、语言与视觉语言模型上做配对案例与稀疏字典的受控比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其结论指出表示读出与空间解释依赖分析目标与观测位置、局部归因可能和实测干预效应不一致，正可服务于核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否留存于内部状态、以及「因果作用」类评价；作为分析基础设施可供近期参照，但本身不研究推理期状态生成。
